In summary, our research is concerned with

the cloning of M. synovaie genes which are homologous with the M. pneumoniae adhesin gene, and the subsequent use of these clones as a probe for the identification of homologous genes in other mycoplasma species.
the identification of a M. synovae DNA fragment encoding proteins with epitopes shared with M. pneumoniae and the adhesin protein of M. gallisepticum.

The main takeaway from our work is that
the adhesin of M. pneumonia is conserved in other species of mycoplasma, and that the conserved regions are likely to be involved in adhesin functions.
